reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; specifically checked that the narrow upper-lip moustache did not expand into chin/jaw hair, plus cap, brows, one mouth, uniform, pose, crop, lighting, collar, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap, small gold front insignia, gold leaf-shaped visor decoration, small dark covered temple area and dark eyebrows remain. Native-resolution inspection confirms a short narrow dark moustache confined to the upper lip, not an expanded beard: the chin and jaw are smooth, and there is one restrained closed mouth below it. No spectacles were added. The nearly frontal capped head angled subtly toward viewer left, matching gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop and warm directional light with visor shadow remain. One dark navy jacket, one visible viewer-left gold shoulder board, white pointed shirt collar, one dark tie and small pale blue-gray collar details remain. The collar is seated around a short broad neck directly below the rounded chin, without a stalk, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and near-opacity values alone were not used to reject.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap/collar insignia and the finest covered temple hair cannot be resolved from the 65x67 source; only visible shapes, metallic colors and placement were compared. The moustache was checked at native output resolution and only the absence of clear chin/jaw expansion is claimed. Note marks remain indistinct rather than readable text.
